team-lead.description: Primary delivery orchestrator. Coordinates Design Evidence → SA → SD → Frontend/Backend → Review → Verify.

design-evidence.description: Extract source-backed Design Evidence Packs from Figma, screenshots, wireframes, and prototypes.

business-analyst.description: SA role: translate evidence into business requirements, rules, states, data meaning, and acceptance intent.

system-designer.description: SD role: translate business requirements into technical, API, data, security, and operational contracts.

frontend-dev.description: Implement frontend routes, interactions, state, accessibility, and visual acceptance from approved contracts.

backend-dev.description: Implement backend APIs, domain logic, persistence, authorization, integrations, and observability from approved contracts.

verifier.description: Run lint, typecheck, tests, and build to verify code changes. Read-only + bash.

code-reviewer.description: Systematic code review across correctness, security, quality, testing, and style dimensions.

test-engineer.description: Generate meaningful tests for source code — unit, integration, and E2E. Framework-aware.

tech-writer.description: Generate and update project documentation — code comments, API docs, README, and CHANGELOG.

architect.description: Capture architecture decisions as ADR documents. Analyzes tradeoffs and records context.

evidence.description: Create a source-backed Design Evidence Pack in docs/specs/<feature>/
evidence.template:
Extract the Design Evidence Pack for this feature. Record sources, observed/inferred/unknown evidence, confidence, and intake metadata.

$ARGUMENTS

business-spec.description: Create business requirements from an approved Design Evidence Pack
business-spec.template:
Read the feature intake and evidence pack, then produce business requirements, rules, states, business data definitions, acceptance intent, and traceability IDs.

$ARGUMENTS

technical-design.description: Create technical, frontend, and backend contracts from approved business requirements
technical-design.template:
Read the evidence pack and business requirements, then produce technical design, frontend contract, backend contract, and traceability mappings.

$ARGUMENTS

frontend.description: Implement a frontend slice from its approved contract
frontend.template:
Implement the approved frontend slice and report its requirement, API, and verification IDs.

$ARGUMENTS

backend.description: Implement a backend slice from its approved contract
backend.template:
Implement the approved backend slice and report its requirement, API, data, and verification IDs.

$ARGUMENTS

review.description: Review code changes across 5 dimensions (correctness, security, quality, testing, style)

test.description: Generate tests for source code — auto-detects framework and conventions
test.template:
Generate tests for the current code.

$ARGUMENTS

docs.description: Generate or update documentation — code comments, README, API docs, ADRs

orchestrate.description: Coordinate multiple agents for complex, multi-domain tasks

adr.description: Create or update an Architecture Decision Record

verify.description: Run lint, typecheck, tests, and build to verify changes
verify.template:
Use the verifier agent to run the full verification suite on the current changes.

$ARGUMENTS
